source.note: ClientHello, HTTP/2 frames and header sets are those captured for firefox-144-macos; wreq-util declares firefox 148 to use the same TLS and HTTP/2 configuration (ff148: tls_options!('4', 'CIPHER_LIST_1', 'CURVES_2', 'KEY_SHARES_2'), http2_options!(1)). The User-Agent is wreq-util's; accept-language is wreq-util's. Nothing was seen on the wire for this version here. wreq-util declares Firefox 136 to 151 equal to 135. Firefox's own release defaults (StaticPrefList.yaml and nsNSSIOLayer.cpp at each FIREFOX_N_0_RELEASE tag) agree up to 150: 0xc009 went off in 151, 0xc00a in 154, and the FFDHE groups left supported_groups in 156 — what the Firefox 155 to 157 captured here show.
